notes: Read the full target, preceding Biden and party diagnosis, all ten candidates and the review. Standardized the asserted working-class political capacity and desired improvement, retained both prediction and evaluation for a second Trump victory, preserved the necessity relation for an independent working-class party, and identified working people as those harmed by capitalist-serving politicians. Restored DSA organizing mechanisms and the assertion that workers deserve more from political parties.

claims.claim_text: DSA believes working people have the political capacity to defeat the ruling class and create a better society.
DSA predicts and evaluates a second Trump victory as catastrophic for the international working class.
An independent party rooted in the working-class majority is characterized as necessary to build a future without exploitation and oppression.
DSA members are said to have challenged the capitalist class through labor and tenant unions, street organizing and socialist electoral campaigns.
Workers are said to be realizing that they deserve more from their political parties.
DSA opposes the capitalist class and politicians who serve capitalist interests at working people's expense.
